title: Post-it note — 3M (Silver/Fry)
problem_statement: A "failed" weak adhesive had no use; bookmarks kept falling out of hymnals. The problem is documented and scoped before any solution work begins.
concept: Spencer Silver's weak adhesive (1968) met Art Fry's bookmark problem (1974) at 3M: repositionable notes. A solution waited years for its problem. Validation emphasis: the listed validation plan is the next work — run the cheapest discriminating test first.
novelty_assessment: Failure-tolerant R&D: the lab kept the "failure" until the use appeared.
